Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial DPA thoughts & timing for SCCs

Hi Sean / Marissa,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's hosting options yesterday. Legal at BlueNorth has a couple of asks before we can commit to the DPA: 1) we need clarity on the international transfer mechanism (SCCs vs UK IDTA addendum), 2) a final subprocessor list, and 3) confirmation on how DocuSign execution will work across signatories (we have two EEA signatories + a UK finance approver).

Attached is our annotated DPA with inline comments (BNF-DPA-redlines-v2.pdf). High-level: we prefer SCCs with a transfer impact assessment, but our GC wants the option to require a UK addendum for UK-regulated data. Can Redwood confirm whether you will accept SCCs + a short UK addendum or insist on an IDTA in our case? Also please provide an expected turnaround for Redwood to apply redlines and return a DocuSign envelope.

Would like to close this by next week if possible.

Best,
Anya Petrova
Senior Counsel, BlueNorth Financial
attachments: BNF-DPA-redlines-v2.pdf
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA thoughts & timing for SCCs

Anya — thanks for the clear note and the annotated DPA. We can do SCCs plus a short UK addendum (bridging language) as an execution option. Below is our proposed plan so legal/finance at BlueNorth can confirm: 

1) Transfer mechanism: default = EU SCCs (we attach a copy with our standard implementation notes). If BlueNorth requires, we will append our UK addendum (UK IDTA-compatible language) — this adds a one-business-day review on our side.

2) Subprocessors: we will provide the up-to-date list (including cloud infra + telemetry vendors) in the next email. If you need advance notice for a specific subprocessor, flag the vendor name and we'll treat it as "approval pending" during signing.

3) DocuSign logistics: we propose serialized signing order — BlueNorth Legal -> BlueNorth Finance -> Redwood Legal (Marissa) -> Redwood Head of Security (Karthik). We'll prepare a DocuSign envelope and share the link. Envelope will include: redlined DPA PDF, SCCs-annotated doc, and a one-page transfer-impact summary.

4) Timing: we can get a Redwood-redlined DPA back same day if we receive only light comments; if you need the UK addendum, add one business day. Target close: 2027-06-07.

I've attached an internal annotated SCCs doc (SCCs-annotated.docx) and started a draft with our preferred redlines; Marissa / Karthik please weigh in on any security-related language we should preserve.

Thanks — I'll queue a DocuSign draft once we confirm signatory order.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments: SCCs-annotated.docx

Date: 2027-06-01T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: proposed redlines + signature order (BlueNorth)

Team — quick notes after reading BlueNorth's comments: 

- Security carveouts: keep the standard monitoring telemetry clause but add a sentence clarifying no customer PII is retained beyond 30 days in logs. Kar thik, confirm whether we need a stronger retention cap.
- Transfer impact: propose a 1-page summary describing mitigation (SCCs + our reassurances: EU tenancy, optional dedicated capacity, KMS controls). I'll draft it.
- Subprocessors: we must disclose the following by EOD: "GCP Compute (us-central1), RedisLabs (KV cache), Sentry (error logging)" — mark RedisLabs as optional for Dedicated customers.
- DocuSign: signature order looks good. Procurement asked for a 1% credit if BlueNorth insists on IDTA rather than SCCs (cost for legal ops time). If they push, I'll escalate to sales leadership.

Action items:
- Marissa: assemble transfer-impact one-pager and update redlines (target 2027-06-01T17:00).
- Karthik: confirm retention language by 14:00.
- Sean: confirm envelope signatory emails and send to BlueNorth once docs are attached.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Counsel, Redwood Inference

> Anya — thanks for the clear note and the annotated DPA. We can do SCCs plus a short UK addendum (bridging language) as an execution option....

Thanks Sean — we appreciate the flexibility. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We reviewed your SCC annotations and proposed two small wording tweaks (see inline comments in BNF-DPA-redlines-v3.pdf). Both are around breach notification timing (we ask 48 hours; Redwood currently has 72 hours in the redline).
- For subprocessors: please mark RedisLabs as "notified" rather than optional — our security team wants to see the vendor explicitly listed in the DPA schedule.
- Execution: we will sign via DocuSign but require that the envelope show the full attachment list (redline + SCCs + transfer-impact summary) prior to signature.

Please send the updated DPA and DocuSign link. If you can include the DocuSign envelope ID in the email, that will speed our internal routing.

Best,
Anya
